label: Bible Study
prompt: For the law was given by Moses, but _____ and truth came by Jesus Christ.
verse: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
note: Moses brought the law — grace and truth arrived in person.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do _____ among you.
verse: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.
note: The night before crossing the Jordan: get ready, for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders.

label: Sunday School
prompt: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod _____ up their rods.
verse: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.
note: Pharaoh's magicians matched the trick, but Aaron's rod had the last word — it swallowed theirs whole.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Behold, I am _____; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
verse: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
note: Faced with God's questions from the whirlwind, Job finally puts his hand over his mouth.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without _____, save in his own country, and in his own house.
verse: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
note: Back home in Nazareth the hometown crowd took offence — and the KJV keeps the British u in 'honour.'
